inquiry.source_body:
Hi Kiko,

We are joining Manila Coffee Festival on 12 to 14 March 2027 at the World Trade Center. Can Blank Space build our booth from the attached diagram? Space is 6 m x 3 m, one side open to the aisle. We need a serving counter, a back wall with our logo and shelves for retail bags.

Thanks,
Bea Villanueva
Kape Isla Coffee Roasters
